Ava: Midweek heads-up 1 1 planning a short freeze for the release train starting Thu 2026-06-04 16:00 UTC to Thu 2026-06-04 22:00 UTC. Purpose: last-mile verifications and tagging releases.
Remy: Quick Q: does this block traffic-split changes for ongoing canaries?
Ava: Yes, routing/splits are blocked. If you need to adjust a canary, file /freeze-exception with rationale + rollback plan.
Kai: We're ramping ranker-v3 to 2% tomorrow. Will the freeze affect the ramp?
Ava: Ramps that start before freeze can continue but no new ramps initiated during the freeze window. Make sure telemetry hooks are green.
DeployBot: Note: MergeGuard active for labels [runtime,model,route] during freeze window. Use /freeze-exception to request bypass.
Eng-SRE Oncall: Standby window Thu 16:00-18:00 UTC. We'll assist with sticky routing restores and fast rollbacks if needed. Ping @Eng-SRE Oncall or DM for immediate help.
Remy: I'll post the canary checklist and command snippet in the release docs.
Ava: Please confirm owner ACK in-thread by Wed EOD so we can publish the frozen list. :lock:
